scope: Minimum next study; completion does not automatically establish convergence or submission readiness.
preconditions: Original v2412 environment and private solver available; verify executable hash.
Prepared baseline 0/constant/system inputs, original tables and source/physics manifests available.
Audit all new carriers and preserve source rates, temperature mapping, thermodynamics and diffusivity.
Use fresh isolated case paths. Do not overwrite baseline or follow-up cases.
If the original binary cannot be reproduced, establish new paired controls before attributing differences to resolution.
execution: Run ten-step smoke tests on every case before full duration.
All new runs start from t=0, not a late checkpoint.
Keep baseline numerical acceptance criteria unchanged; preserve logs, element ledgers and final native profiles.
analysis: Recompute raw element residues, solver defects, equilibrium failures and inventory bounds.
Compare full iodine and iodide profiles, totals, centroids, widths, native-bin maxima and normalised transport distances.
Spatial: assess 18432/41472/93312-cell sequences alongside all four meshes; reject oscillatory or nondecreasing extrapolations.
Iteration: compare eight-corrector full-run outputs against matched three-corrector baselines and inspect startup as well as late time.
Report all outcomes including unsuccessful convergence; retain original figures and assumptions.
contingencies: If spatial differences remain nondecreasing, refine further or verify a bounded higher-order scheme separately.
If time-space interaction becomes material, add matched 1 ms runs on refined meshes.
Any altered solver or transport scheme needs regression qualification and new matched controls.

current_evidence.scope: Original specification and case statuses above describe the 12 October plan. The original runner archive is preserved. No new CFD runs were launched during reconciliation.

spatial_refinement.scope: Saved L4 profiles are available for this branch only; other planned L4 runs are not included in the pulled evidence.
